info.title: NIFTY options backtester API
info.description: Saved backtest runs (config, manifest, trade log, daily marks, equity curve, metrics, yearly and monthly tables) and launching new runs. Numbers are served exactly as saved in each run folder; GET requests never recompute anything.

get.description:
Every saved run, newest first, with its status. A broken run folder is listed as
`invalid` with its problems instead of breaking the list.

schema.title: Response List Runs Api Runs Get

post.description:
Run a short-straddle backtest and save it, as `nifty-backtest backtest` does.
Waits until the run has finished; with five years of data that takes a while.

get.description:
Status, full config, manifest (git commit, data fingerprints) and which files the
run folder holds.
metrics.json as saved. 409 if metrics were never computed for this run.

schema.title: Response Run Yearly Api Runs  Run Id  Yearly Get
Response Run Monthly Api Runs  Run Id  Monthly Get

get.description:
Daily net and gross equity, drawdowns and the NIFTY 50 TRI curve (daily.csv), for
charts. 409 for runs whose metrics predate daily.csv, with the command that adds it.

schema.title: Response Run Daily Api Runs  Run Id  Daily Get
Response Run Trades Api Runs  Run Id  Trades Get

get.description: One trade with its mark-to-market on every day it was held.
The equity curve exactly as saved in equity.csv (net of costs).

schema.title: Response Run Equity Api Runs  Run Id  Equity Get
Response Run Skipped Api Runs  Run Id  Skipped Get

DailyPoint.title: DailyPoint
DailyPoint.description:
One day of daily.csv (M6): the series behind the dashboard charts, computed by the
metrics code (never by the API or the browser). Drawdowns are positive fractions or
rupees below the running peak; benchmark columns are None if the TRI was unavailable.

DataSettings.title: DataSettings
DataSettings.description:
The data window and paths a run used. Other DataConfig settings (download politeness
and so on) are passed through as they were saved.

EquityPoint.title: EquityPoint
EquityPoint.description:
Account value at one close (equity.csv). A run with no trades saves only date and
equity, so the other two columns are optional.

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description: Every error response has this shape.

Headline.title: Headline
Headline.description: A few numbers from metrics.json for the run list (net of costs).

MarkRow.title: MarkRow
MarkRow.description: One trade on one day (marks.csv). Values are None where a mark is missing.

gross_minus_slippage_minus_charges_minus.title: Gross Minus Slippage Minus Charges Minus Net

final_equity_minus_capital_minus_trade_n.title: Final Equity Minus Capital Minus Trade Net

yearly_net_by_expiry_minus_total.title: Yearly Net By Expiry Minus Total

yearly_pnl_by_date_minus_total.title: Yearly Pnl By Date Minus Total

notional_daily_sum_minus_trade_sum.title: Notional Daily Sum Minus Trade Sum

Reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.description: Each check should be ~0; None means it needed a missing value and was not possible.

start.title: Start
start.description: first day; default: the data config's start

RunRequest.title: RunRequest
RunRequest.description: Parameters for POST /api/runs: the same choices `nifty-backtest backtest` offers.

StrategySettings.title: StrategySettings
StrategySettings.description:
Every strategy has a name, entry timing and lot count; its other parameters pass
through as saved, so new strategies need no change here.

TradeDetail.title: TradeDetail
TradeDetail.description: A single trade with its daily marks (drill-down).

TradeRecord.title: TradeRecord
TradeRecord.description: One row of trades.csv (M3 trade log, with context columns).
